matches.rationale: No finding mentions the fabricated references; findings cover data inconsistencies and methodology, not citation fabrication.
Both identify a logical inconsistency in the LayerCast description (Section 4) about whether computations are performed in BF16 or upcast to FP32 at runtime, capturing the method logic flaw.
No finding addresses LayerCast's reported 0% Std@Acc or the unrealistic perfect reproducibility claim; pred 4's concern is about FP32's tiny SD values, not LayerCast's results.
No finding discusses OOM asymmetry or missing FP32 configurations; pred 5 and 10 focus on configuration count inconsistencies, not unfair comparison from memory constraints.
The oversimplification attributing variability solely to non-associativity is not flagged; pred 1 deals with a different numerical inconsistency in the abstract.
The hyperbolic claim in the conclusion about FP32-level determinism is not identified; pred 7 concerns the method description, not the conclusion's overselling.
No finding mentions the omission of environmental or energy cost discussion; ethical dimensions are not addressed by any prediction.
The introduction's contradictory statements about fixed random seeds and nondeterminism are not detected by any finding.
No finding identifies the cherry-picking or exclusion of catastrophic BF16 failure modes; table inconsistency findings do not address selective reporting of variance.
The oversimplified attribution of BF16 variance solely to mantissa bits is not captured; no prediction discusses this interpretive distortion.
Both highlight that Pass@1 evaluations using 4, 16, 64 runs lack justification and confidence intervals, indicating insufficient experimental design rigor.
The confusing relationship between random seeds and numerical precision in Preliminaries is not mentioned by any finding.
The overstated severity claim in the introduction is not identified; no finding addresses this rhetorical distortion.
The exceptional case where FP32 variance exceeds BF16 is not noted; findings do not cover this internal incoherence.
The missing limitations discussion in the appendix is not flagged by any prediction.
The exaggerated rhombi count (480 vs 960) in Figure 1 caption is not detected; pred 1 and 6 discuss accuracy ranges, not this specific numerical fabrication.
The use of subtly different random seeds is not mentioned; no finding addresses this experimental protocol flaw.
The overgeneralization in Related Work is not identified; no finding covers this literature distortion.
The contradiction between similar rounding errors and divergent empirical variances is not captured; no finding mentions this inconsistency.
The lack of crucial LayerCast implementation details (non-linear layers, etc.) is not raised; pred 7 notes a contradiction in the given steps, not missing information.
